mentions.name: etoku
mentions.description: Language learning platform for Japanese. Users pick works (TV, movies, books) they want to understand, and each new card is a sentence from native content containing one unknown word or grammar point. All cards include audio and a screenshot, with nothing AI generated — everything comes from real native content. The first 150 concepts are hand-curated because the most frequent concepts in native material don't make a great intro to the language; content is being scraped and an analyzer that breaks sentences into the concepts needed to understand them is being improved. The platform is not ready for real usage yet.
mentions.problem: The most frequent concepts in native material don't make a great intro to the Japanese language, so the intro course needed hand-curated concepts; the platform is not yet ready for real usage.
mentions.audience: People who want to learn and understand Japanese
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm working on etoku (https://etoku.app), what I believe is the most efficient and fun way to learn Japanese. You pick the works (TV, movies, books) that you want to understand and each new card is a sentence from native content with one word or grammar point you don't know yet. All of the cards have audio and a screenshot.
